posts.title: West Valley Newcomers : Point Guards
posts.contentText: This offseason we have seen some major movement especially in the West Valley. With the continued growth of Arizona we also see players coming in from out of state and even some from out of county. In this article I will highlight the new faces in the West Valley who have the opportunity to make some noise for there new squads. The list will include new faces coming from different areas in the state, out of state, out of county, Incoming Freshman and even players who played freshman or jv last year who will now be on varsity. [{"id":1965604,"date":"2026-10-31T09:39:31","link":"https://prepgirlshoops.com/2026/10/2027-rankings-best-season-for-last/","title":{"rendered":"2027 Rankings: Best Season For Last"},"content":{"rendered":"

It’s hard to believe that the class of 2027 are on the eve of their last high school basketball seasons. For a lot of the senior girls basketball players in the state it will be the last competitive, team-sport season that they will enjoy. Some however, have and will be choosing where they continue to play the game on the next level. One player on this list, Marleigh Dale Marleigh Dale 6'0" | C Banks County | 2027 State GA , is being recruited for an entirely different sport (track and field) by multiple division schools across the country. The twins have chosen their college home and the rest will be making that tough decision soon. I have no doubts they have saved their best play for their final season.
